title: Vertical Privilege Escalation to Institution Settings
description: Routes for /settings (index, save, uploadLogo, uploadSeal, uploadSignature, resetTheme, notificationTemplates) reside in general staff.access middleware without Spatie permission:manage settings gate. Any staff member (including teachers) can view and modify institutional settings.

title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Circulars
description: Circular content is rendered unescaped via {!! $circular->content !!} without HTMLPurifier or strict tag sanitization in CircularOrderController, allowing arbitrary script execution on viewer browsers.
remediation: Implement HTMLPurifier or strict strip_tags whitelist in CircularOrderController store/update and on render

title: Unescaped Shell Command Interpolation on Windows Backup
description: In SystemAdminController::triggerBackup, on Windows the password is concatenated into 'set PGPASSWORD={$password} && ' without escaping, posing command injection / syntax breakage risks if password contains special shell characters.
remediation: Pass environment variables via proc_open env array rather than shell string concatenation with exec()

title: Missing Route-Level Rate Limiting on Public Fee Checkout
description: POST /pay/fee/{classId} is publicly exposed without authentication and lacks throttle middleware, exposing endpoint to automated brute-force carding or denial-of-service spam.

title: Insecure Session Cookie Flags in Production Environment
description: SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE is set to false in .env. When deployed over HTTPS, session cookies lack the Secure attribute, exposing session tokens to transmission over unencrypted channels.
remediation: Set SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE=true in production environment configuration

title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP) & HSTS Headers
description: HTTP responses include X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, and X-XSS-Protection, but omit Content-Security-Policy (CSP) and Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS).
remediation: Add strict baseline Content-Security-Policy and Strict-Transport-Security to SecurityHeaders middleware

title: Transitive Composer Package Vulnerabilities (Dompdf / PhpSpreadsheet / Symfony)
description: composer audit identified CVE-2026-59943, CVE-2026-59942, CVE-2026-56722 in dompdf <3.1.6 (SVG file read/DoS); CVE-2026-40863, CVE-2026-59931 in phpspreadsheet; CVE-2026-108082 in symfony/http-foundation; CVE-2026-109413 in symfony/yaml.
remediation: Execute controlled composer update dompdf/dompdf phpoffice/phpspreadsheet symfony/http-foundation symfony/yaml during Stage 9

title: Transitive NPM Package Vulnerabilities (shell-quote / axios / vite)
description: npm audit identified GHSA-pqg4-j6r4-53mv in shell-quote (Critical command injection via concurrently); multiple CVEs in axios (ReDoS & prototype pollution); and vite <=7.3.6 (Windows launch-editor execution).
remediation: Update devDependencies and execute npm audit fix during Stage 9
